build_mistral_from_huggingface: build a Penzai transformer model from a HuggingFace MistralForCausalLM instance
convert_mistral_upcast_float32: convert a HuggingFace Mistral model to Penzai with activations upcast to float32
convert_mistral_use_layer_stack: convert a HuggingFace Mistral model to Penzai using a layer stack for decoder blocks
validate_mistral_config: validate that a HuggingFace Mistral model config is supported by the Penzai converter
run_mistral_conversion: run the mistral_from_huggingface_model function to convert a MistralForCausalLM to TransformerLM
